name: The Brake-Count
description: A carter's slate kept wedged under the bench's plinth, chalked on both sides: one side in yellow carter's chalk, the other in a white chalk that does not smudge when you rub it.

name: A Writ, Unserved
description: A writ of the Charter folded small, its wax seal unbroken, the back of it written over in a bailiff's pencil and weighted under a pebble at the foot of the stone.

name: The Clerk's Count
description: A page cut from the Counting Tower's day-book with a clerk's penknife, ruled in faded red and splashed with trough water.

name: A Letter to the Guild, Unsent
description: A draft letter on good guild paper, much crossed out, left under a pebble on the heap where the rain has got at the ink.

name: A Carter's Notching Knife
description: A short knife worn to a sliver from a lifetime of notching the Fair-Day Stone, left jammed in a crack in its lake face with its handle wound in blue thread.

name: The Trap Book
description: A trapper's tally in a tin box against the damp, the pages soft as cloth and smelling of smoke and eel.

name: Concerning the Fourth Stone
description: A notice nailed to a post by the stones, the nail rusted in, with a second hand's answer written under the first.

name: The Code
description: A strip of oilcloth rolled tight and pushed into the back of the lamp niche, soot-black on the outside and written on the inside in grease pencil.

name: Hesper's Strake
description: A length of the boat's planking prised off her ribs, the inside of it carved all over in a hand that learned its letters late.

name: The Listener's Leaves
description: Loose leaves of Sayers' paper pinned under a tuning tine on the writing-board, the notes on them written as marks on a ruled line.

name: A Twist of Grey Salt
description: A twist of coarse grey sea-salt in a scrap of indigo cloth, left on the threshold of the Salt Barn at the end of the line laid across it.

name: The Watch Roll
description: The Serpent Watch's roll, a strip of hide nailed under the cairn's seat-stone, the names scored into it with an awl and the last few fresh.

name: The Waiting Tally
description: A gate-ward's stick kept wedged between two of the stones, notched for every traveller sent down to wait, with a long gouge at its end.

name: A Smoker's Note
description: A curl of birch bark pushed through the pike hook, written on the white side in charcoal.

name: Judgements Given at the Chair
description: A list of judgements written out fair by a Merrowhithe hand and tucked into the hawthorn's fork, where the reeve's hand would have rested.

name: The Burner's Nights
description: A burner's count of nights kept on a board propped against the lean-to, a charcoal stroke for each, the strokes running off the board onto the pole beside it.

name: A Trader's Reckoning
description: A folded paper wedged under the cairn's cap-stone, a trader's reckoning of a market day with a split pebble weighing it down.

name: The Bier Roll
description: A strip of oiled hide tied round the Bier Stone, the Rudd dead listed on it in Skerrish by the clan's memory-keeper, notch for notch.

name: A Herder's Wall-Tally
description: A herder's tally of nights and weather scratched into a flake of limestone that has come away from the cave wall, smoke-black on one side.

name: The Tinkers' Key
description: A tinker's key to the marks, scratched on the lid of a tin and left in the lee of the stone for whoever is new to the road.

name: What Is in the Eye
description: A child's tally of the eye's offerings on a smooth bone chip, kept tucked under the skull's brow where it is dry.

name: The Drip Book
description: A thin book of scraped goatskin kept wrapped in wax-cloth in a niche over the basin, a name for every child brought to the Drip.

name: The Answer
description: A verse written out in careful Skerrish on the back of a Kharrow blood-price receipt, left weighted on the singer's stone with a Kharrow bone token.

name: The Stray Tally
description: A tally of strays swapped at the cairn, kept on a flat stone slipped into its south side, the Ghast marks in soot and the Oskel ones scratched.

name: The Watch's Inventory
description: The Dale Watch's inventory of the Horn Hole, burned into a wooden board with a hot iron and hung on a peg inside the mouth.

name: The First Drips
description: A tapper's list of trees and their first drips, scratched on a pine shingle and wedged into the resin on the back of the shrine stone.

name: A Markless Bone Token
description: A clan-child's token of giant bone, beautifully cut and worn smooth as if carried for years, bearing a mark of an eye over eight strokes that no clan owns.

name: The Oath on the Bench
description: A charcoal rubbing of the oath cut into the bench's back, taken on a sheet of Tollmere paper by someone who meant to take it to the Moot and did not.

name: The Keeper's Stack-Count
description: A beacon-keeper's count of peat cut and stacked, knotted into a length of cord hanging inside the shieling door.

name: A Memory-Keeper's Warning
description: A warning written on a flake of slate and propped against the broken stump of the waystone where every traveller on the Moot road would have to step round it.

name: A Vigil Note
description: A few lines written in charcoal from the dead fire on the inside of a sheepskin, left folded on the vigil stool.

name: The Wood-Tally
description: A tally of firewood bundles cut into the hold's doorpost under the hacked-off lintel, a notch for every bundle carried to Dreughow.

name: The Fire Count
description: A child's count of the Clanless Camp's fires, chalked evening by evening on the underside of the lookout's watcher-stone.

name: A Word Sent Up
description: A scrap of slate sent up the mine in a shift's ore-basket and brought down to the cairn by his mother, who laid it beside the pebble with his name.

name: The Ward's Log
description: A cart-ward's log of carts walked and what was taken, cut on a stave kept stuck upright in the ground beside the stacked shields.

name: The Carters' Oath
description: A carters' rhyme cut on a strip of pine bark and pinned to the pine behind the stone, the bark shiny where hands have rubbed it after the stone.

name: The Porters' Manifest
description: A porters' manifest scratched on a board by the mule-lines, the last entry circled three times.

name: The Link-Keeper's Roll
description: A link-keeper's roll of links struck and restored, scratched on a length of iron strap and hung at the end of the line of links.

name: The Brother's Words
description: Words cut into the underside of the bench's seat-stone, where only someone lying on the ground to look would find them.

name: A Builder's Reckoning
description: A builder's reckoning of timber, scratched in a neat Skerrish hand on a beam-end left over in the ore-house doorway.

name: The Gate-Warden's Count
description: The gate-warden's count of the Last Cairn's stones, knotted into a cord tied round its base and frozen stiff.

name: The Cutters' Tally
description: An ice-cutters' tally of blocks sawn and sledged down, scratched on the blade of a broken ice-saw left standing in the drift.

name: The Rope's Count
description: A count of the knots on the rope and whose names they hold, kept by the shrine's Brindle keeper on a birch-bark roll tucked into the stone's hole.

name: The Overseer's Check
description: An overseer's check of shifts up and down, chalked on a slate hung from a nail driven into the Shift Stone.

name: Gann's Rope-Book
description: A goatherd's list of his beasts and their ropes, scratched on the inside of the shieling's door-hurdle with the point of a knife.

name: A Debtor's Tally-Cord
description: A blood-price tally-cord cut down from Kharrow Hole and marked paid with a red thread, left looped over the middle stone beside a sleeping man's cloak-pin.

name: The Moot's Word on the Grass
description: A copy of the Moot's judgement on the Skarldale grass, written on a sheep's shoulder-blade and wedged into a crack at the foot of the Neither Stone.

name: A Heifer's Bell
description: A heifer's bell of beaten copper with its clapper tied up in wool, left hung on a peg of bone driven into the skull's brow.

name: The Smelt-Book
description: A smelter's book of ingots laid and taken up, kept on a board nailed to the pine over the stone, the board scorched where hot ingots were set against it.

name: The Namers' List
description: A list of the youths who waited and crossed, cut into the stool's legs, one leg for each generation, the newest leg nearly full.

name: The Chain-Ward's Chalk
description: A copy of the news on the stone, taken down onto a scrap of Tollmere paper by the chain-ward, who wants it seen that he did not write the last of it.

name: An Old Toll-Coin
description: A heavy coin of clan silver struck before the Chain Years, a chain-link on one face and a giant's hand on the other, laid on the old toll-shelf in the snow.

name: The Smelters' Names
description: A list of the smelters whose slag is on the cairn, painted on a flat slab of slag in white lead and propped at the cairn's foot.

name: What the Stones Sang
description: A miner's note of what the stones sang, the notes written as notches along a strip of leather bootlace tied through the middle stone's hole.

name: How the Fire Is Laid
description: A Woodfolk forester's instructions for laying the fire, cut into a slat of oak and tied to the lean-to's ridge-pole with bast.

name: Rubbings from the Lodge
description: A sheaf of charcoal rubbings of the mason's marks on the lodge's door-jamb, left folded in a crack of the jamb by a Sayers' student who ran out of paper.

name: What the Clansman Heard
description: A clan drover's account of what he heard at the stone, scratched on a scrap of hide and pinned to the stone's bow-knot with a thorn.

name: The Torch Count
description: A count of torches taken and given, knotted into a cord tied to the basket's handle, the knots stiff with pitch.

name: A Reel of Knotted Silk
description: A gatherer's reel wound with pale weaver silk already spun into thread, knotted at every hand's length in a pattern of three and five.

name: A Forester's Evening
description: A forester's notes of clan fires counted from the bench, written on the white inside of a strip of birch bark and tucked under the cairn's top stone.

name: An Oroth Mason's Wedge
description: An iron wedge of Oroth make, black and unrusted, found lying in the moss at the foot of the block that moved, its striking face bright as if it had been hammered last night.

name: The Planters' Round
description: A planters' list of notches answered, cut into a hazel stick with a sapling's name beside each notch, tied to the trench's marker post.

name: The Tender's List
description: A moss-tender's list of the mosses on the bed and the dead they are for, written in oak-gall ink on a board kept under the bark roof.

name: The Vigil Roll
description: A Hart-Knight's roll of vigils kept, lettered on vellum and rolled into a hollow antler tine hung by a thong from the tent-pole.

name: The Brother's Strides
description: A woodfolk child's measure of the Fourth Brother's strides, a line of hazel pegs driven into the verge behind the stone, the newest three pale and fresh-cut.

name: A Count of Fires
description: A count of fires seen to the east, chalked on the flat stones round the cold hearth in a small, careful hand.

name: A Keeper's Mark-Stick
description: A Rookhold keeper's mark-stick for the Briar root, notched for each visit and carved at its head with the Old Gate's sign, driven into the ground by the mouth.

name: The Lamp-Runner's Card
description: A lamp-runner's card of dusks, a square of bark with a knot burned into it for every evening the lamp was lit from the Hearth, hung inside the shrine's hood.

name: What Was Not Said
description: A folded sheet of bark-paper wedged between two of the stones, the unsaid half of a Fernhold argument written out in full and never delivered.

name: The Smith's Order Book
description: An antler-smith's order book, the leather cover scorched, left open on the forge's cold hearth-stone with a pair of tongs laid across it.

name: A Relic-Dealer's Prices
description: A price list in a Tollmere dealer's hand, the paper greasy and folded into eighths, dropped by the pegged hides.

name: Wenna's Wish
description: A Vale woman's last wishes, written on good Tamwick paper and kept in a clay jar sealed with wax, set on the ledge of the house's one standing gable.

name: The Carriers' Tally
description: An oil-carriers' tally, a notched yoke-peg for every jar carried to the Moot, kept on a thong round the stone's waist.

name: The Verderer's Count
description: The verderer's autumn count of harts, written small on a strip of deerskin and tied round the stone's neck below the carved head.

name: A Carter's Cup
description: A horn cup on a leather thong, hung from the tallest of the leaning stones for tipping the stones their share, the horn stained dark with cider.

name: A Carter's Question
description: A Tamwick carter's question, chalked on a slate and propped against the untaken loaf, the chalk already blurred by a week of dew.

name: A Letter from Tamwick
description: A letter from the family who built the lodge, left in a tin under the hearth-stone for whoever of the Wold would read it.

name: The Pickers' Weights
description: A pickers' tally of trays dried and weighed, scratched on a flat stone by the scales, lit faintly green where fungus dust has worked into the scratches.

name: The Rafters' Flood Roll
description: The rafters' roll of floods marked on the stone, lettered on a strip of oiled canvas and wrapped round the stone below the lowest mark.

name: The Round-Book
description: Hazelwick's round-book of stools and their turns, bound between two hazel boards and left on a stack of hurdles by the fire.

name: The Locker Tally
description: A tally of poles and ropes in the locker, cut into the alder root at the mouth, with a line of fresh cuts at the end that no rafter owns to.

name: The Watch Kept
description: A wall-watcher's night notes, written on a strip of bark with a burnt stick and left in the lean-to, the last lines trailing off the edge.

name: A Tamwick Toast
description: A toast written out on the back of a Tamwick cider-press label, pinned under the cup on the shrine stone and gone soft with the damp.

name: A Note Left in the Middle
description: A note folded under a stone in the exact middle of the bench's seat, in a sawyer's big square capitals.
